name: Kirkland Signature Organic Plain Nonfat Greek Yogurt
whyItWorks: Traditional triple-straining removes most of the liquid whey, leaving dense protein and live active probiotic cultures with substantially less lactose than regular milk. Completely fat-free and smooth.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy chilled with a drizzle of pure maple syrup. Tolerated well by many who cannot drink fluid milk.
